d:
'101' sees the duo exchange their trademark, instantly quotable punchlines over a spacious, self-produced club-friendly beat that leaves ample room for Encore ABJ and Calm to flex their lyrical dexterity.
Produced by - Calm
Mixed & Mastered by - Arsh Sharma / Fuzzculture
Art By Debjyoti Saha
Seedhe Maut
Azadi Records
